value.name: aligns the two pages
value.description: Asha slides the two sheets together and aligns their margins so the paragraphs sit parallel under the lamp.
evidence: Asha drew the two sheets together until they overlapped, edge to edge, lining the long downstrokes of the firmer hand against the looser ones beneath until the paragraphs sat one atop the other under the lamp.

value.name: asks which handwriting is hers
value.description: Asha looks at Lucia and quietly asks which of the two scripts belongs to her.
evidence: "Which one is hers?" she asked, no louder than the radiator's tick.

value.name: Lucia traces the handwriting difference
value.description: Lucia points out the divergence between the two scripts by tracing the differing letters and pen pressure on the page.
evidence: Lucia's fingertip went to the page before her mouth did, tracing the gap where the two scripts diverged in the slant of an l, the tail of a y, the way the firmer hand pressed the pen at the end of each line as if someone wanted to be sure of being read.

value.name: Lucia seeks Rosa's permission
value.description: Lucia looks to Rosa before answering, waiting to see whether Rosa will allow her to identify the handwriting.
evidence: Her finger stopped on the looser stroke, and she looked sideways at Rosa before she answered, waiting to see whether Rosa would let her say it.

value.name: Rosa permits Lucia to speak
value.description: Rosa gives Lucia a slow nod, signaling that she may say what she has identified.
evidence: Rosa's eyes moved from the diverging script to Lucia's fingertip where it rested on the looser stroke, and she gave a single slow nod
